recentItems.title: How old is the Earth?: Crash Course Geology #17
recentItems.description:
What do iron deposits, fossils, and radioactive meteorites have in common? They’re all keeping records of our geologic history, the unimaginably long period of time that our Earth has been swinging around the sun. In this episode, we’ll look back into geologic time, discovering what we know, how we know it, and what it all means.
